Business info Step 1
⚠ Use the CLIENT's own address, not yours. setup.sql creates the login from this, so reusing one address across clients gives them all the same account.
Starter products Optional

Type the client’s real menu here during handover and their POS opens on their own products instead of the demo list. One product per line: Name, Price, Category, Stock. Category and stock are optional — a blank stock means unlimited. Use | instead of a comma if a product name contains one. Leave the box empty to keep the built-in sample list.

Empty — the built-in sample list will be used.

📋 How to get the URL and key
① Inside your new project → click Project Settings (gear icon, left sidebar)
② Click API in the settings menu
③ Under Project URL → copy the URL → paste below (without https://)
④ Under Project API keys → copy the anon / public key → paste below

Waiting queue Step 5

For cafes, restaurants and bakeries. Every sale takes the next number for the day and the receipt prints it in large type. Staff tap Ready in the POS when the order is made, and a wall screen at /queue/ shows the number and calls it out loud.

Not offered for this business type. A waiting queue only makes sense where customers wait for an order to be prepared — pick Cafe, Restaurant or Bakery in Step 1 to enable it.
Adds the queue screen file and the POS Queue tab
ARK‑1, ARK‑2… Type ARK not ARK- — the dash is added automatically. Leave blank for plain numbers.
Prints receipt automatically after every checkout
Must match your thermal printer's paper roll
Spoken by the queue screen. Can be muted on the screen itself.
About the queue screen
It is read-only by construction — it sees today's numbers and their state, nothing else, and cannot write to the database at all. Numbers reset daily and are handed out by the server so two tills never give the same number twice.
